title: Observations
summary: Logging what you notice about yourself, next to what you ate and did.
description: Feelings, what the body did, urges, thoughts: the half of a day the numbers are usually kept for. With a time on them they can be compared with meals and sleep.

stories.as: someone who gets bloated some afternoons
stories.want: to log it when it happens
stories.soThat: I can see whether it follows what I ate

requirements.text: An observation is logged with a time, zero or more tags from the user's categories, and an optional note.

history.text: An observation is logged with a time and a category.
history.reason: Version 1 required one category; an observation can carry several tags or none.

requirements.text: Categories are a list the user owns and can add to and remove from; a new install starts with `observation.starters`.

history.text: Categories are a list the user owns and can add to; a new install starts with three.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't say categories can be removed or which three a new install has.

requirements.text: A new category's emoji is chosen by the model; with no API key or a failed call, 💭 is stored.

history.text: A new category's emoji is chosen by the model; without one, 💭 is shown.
history.reason: Version 1 said 💭 is only shown; it is stored with the category.

requirements.text: Adding a category whose name differs from an existing one only in case or spacing reuses the existing one.

history.text: Category names match regardless of case and spacing.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't say what matching is for.
